notes: Fix: after a session stops, the lag bar is empty again; it shows only during a session and stays empty while paused.
New: in Blind, when paused or before you start, the next-word and next-ayah buttons read on in your mind: the words appear and count as read.
Change: a session in Hidden is practice: its correct words no longer count in Progress, Stats and Review; its mistakes still do.
New: insertion mistakes: a red bolt marks an extra word said before a word. Double tap between two words to add or remove one.
New: a word's window has "+ Inserted before", and the bolt's window plays the extra word you said.
New: Export asks what to include (settings and logs, mistake history, recordings) and shows the size of each.
New: Settings > Profile can keep a copy of your profile for the PC in Download/Meddeb (off unless you tick it).
Fix: a session of several hours no longer crashes when decoding falls far behind, and saving a long recording no longer copies it whole.
